> 第3章 丹体觉醒（第1页）
丹老淡淡一笑，“你也感觉到了，这酒中有一丝造化涅槃丹的残余药力，自然能够修复你的丹田。”
“啊！多谢前辈。”陈长生大喜之下立即跪伏在丹老面前恭恭敬敬的磕了几个响头。
“前辈大恩，如同再造，晚辈感激不尽，他日一定报答！”
丹老笑眯眯的受了陈长生几个头，口中喃喃道：“造化一出，混沌必现，是福，是祸……”
陈长生不懂丹老说的是什么意思，他磕完头之后就盘膝坐下，因为很快他的丹田就被修复，所有的裂缝都开始弥合。
而且他的丹田还发生了变化，在中心处一个旋涡出现，陈长生内视之下才发现原来是一个丹炉在快速旋转。
陈长生简直不敢置信，“怎么回事，我的丹田之中怎么会有一个丹炉？”这种事情简直匪夷所思。
很快，在丹炉的快速旋转之下，一丝丝灵力逸散而出，修复着他受损的丹田。
而且陈长生的丹田在快速扩张，一同扩张的还有他的经脉。
一股玄之又玄的信息涌入识海之中。
渐渐地，陈长生明白了，原来他觉醒了一种特殊体质--混沌丹体，又叫归墟道体。
这种体质必须要造化之气来激发才能觉醒，陈长生喝的那酒之中有造化涅槃丹的气息，因此才能觉醒体质。
否则的话他或许一辈子都觉醒不了这个体质。
这次的劫难，竟然是他崛起的一个契机！
最终，陈长生的丹田气海已经扩大了十倍，而且比之前还要坚韧，他的经脉也扩大了几倍。
体内灵气运转了一个周天，他的修为变成炼气一层，终于又可以修炼了。
“前辈，我……我的丹田修复了，而且变得比之前更加强大！”
陈长生的肉身也变得更加强大，原来他内修炼出来的是混沌之气，而普通修士修炼的是五行之气。

混沌之气比五行之气的品质要高的多，因此改善他的体质也没有什么。
丹老手捻胡须笑眯眯的看着陈长生，“混沌丹体，理应如此，混沌丹炉，炼化一切，这下这些废丹可以变废为宝了。”
陈长生心中一凛，这个丹老似乎是不简单啊，看起来什么事情都知道一样，居然知道自己是混沌丹体。
两百多年前就在这里，没准是个高人。
“呵呵，你回收废丹试试，我很期待哦，不过以你的修为只能回收一品丹药。”
“不错，这边这一堆都是一品的废聚气丹，你可以试试。”丹老的眼中也露出一丝期待，据说混沌丹体有个特殊的功能，就是可以回收废丹。
陈长生抓了一把废弃的聚气丹，这些聚气丹乌黑一片，还有着淡淡的毒气散发出来，是丹房炼废了的。
陈长生心念一动，这些废丹就被他体内的混沌丹炉给吸了进去。
丹老眼中精芒一闪，“陈长生，以混沌之气催动丹炉！”
陈长生照着做，开始催动丹田内的一丝混沌之气，那丹炉果然被点燃，开始了炼化回收的过程。
“这么神奇！”陈长生大吃一惊，他在丹房炼过丹，知道炼丹的难度有多么巨大，特别是火候极难掌握。
自己如果能够回收废丹的话，那岂不是要发财了！

> Chapter 3 Alchemy Awakening (Page 1)
Elder Dan smiled faintly, "You have also felt it. There is a trace of the residual medicinal power of the Nirvana Pill in this wine, which can naturally repair your Dantian."
"Ah! Thank you, senior." Chen Changsheng was overjoyed and immediately knelt down in front of Elder Dan and kowtowed several times respectfully.
"Senior's great kindness is like reinventing the wheel. I'm so grateful to this junior. I will definitely repay you in the future!"
Elder Dan smiled and received Chen Changsheng's head a few times, and murmured: "When good luck comes, chaos will appear. It is a blessing or a curse..."
Chen Changsheng didn't understand what Elder Dan meant. After kowtowing, he sat cross-legged because his Dantian was soon repaired and all the cracks began to be closed.
Moreover, his Dantian also changed. A vortex appeared in the center. When Chen Changsheng looked inside, he discovered that it was a rapidly rotating alchemy furnace.
Chen Changsheng simply couldn't believe it, "What's going on? Why is there an alchemy furnace in my dantian?" This kind of thing is simply unbelievable.
Soon, under the rapid rotation of the alchemy furnace, a trace of spiritual power escaped, repairing his damaged Dantian.
Moreover, Chen Changsheng's Dantian was expanding rapidly, and his meridians were also expanding at the same time.
A mysterious and mysterious information poured into the sea of ​​consciousness.
Gradually, Chen Changsheng understood that he had awakened a special physique - Chaos Alchemy Body, also called Guixu Tao Body.
This kind of constitution must be stimulated by the energy of creation before it can be awakened. The wine Chen Changsheng drank contained the breath of the Nirvana Pill of Creation, so the constitution can be awakened.
Otherwise, he might never be able to awaken this physique in his lifetime.
This disaster turned out to be an opportunity for him to rise!
In the end, Chen Changsheng's Dantian Qi Sea had expanded tenfold and was stronger than before, and his meridians had also expanded several times.
The spiritual energy in his body circulated for a week, and his cultivation level reached the first level of Qi refining, and he was finally able to practice again.
"Senior, I...my Dantian has been repaired, and it has become stronger than before!"
Chen Changsheng's physical body also became more powerful. It turned out that what he cultivated was the energy of chaos, while ordinary monks cultivated the energy of the five elements.
The Qi of Chaos is of much higher quality than the Qi of the Five Elements, so there is nothing to improve his physique.
Old Dan twirled his beard and looked at Chen Changsheng with a smile, "Chaos Dan Body, it should be like this. Chaos Dan Furnace can refine everything. Now these waste pills can be turned into treasures."
Chen Changsheng was shocked. This elixir seemed to be not simple. He seemed to know everything. He actually knew that he was a chaotic elixir body.
He was here more than two hundred years ago, so he might be an expert.
"Haha, you try to recycle the waste elixir. I'm looking forward to it, but with your cultivation level, you can only recycle the first grade elixir."
"Yes, this pile here is full of first-grade waste Qi Gathering Pills. You can try it." Elder Dan's eyes also showed a hint of expectation. It is said that the Chaos Pill Body has a special function, that is, it can recycle waste pills.
Chen Changsheng grabbed a handful of discarded Qi Gathering Pills. These Qi Gathering Pills were black in color and exuded a faint poisonous gas. They were the ones that had been spent in the alchemy room.
With a thought in Chen Changsheng's mind, these useless pills were sucked in by the Chaos Pill Furnace in his body.
Elder Dan's eyes flashed, "Chen Changsheng, use the energy of chaos to activate the alchemy furnace!"
Chen Changsheng did as he was told and began to activate a trace of chaotic energy in his dantian. As expected, the alchemy furnace was ignited and the process of refining and recycling began.
"So miraculous!" Chen Changsheng was shocked. He had made elixirs in the alchemy room and knew how difficult it was to make elixirs, especially the difficulty in mastering the heat.
If I could recycle waste elixirs, wouldn't I make a fortune!
